blocks.zh: Topic A.1 — Setting Alert Levels and Action Limits | 設定警報水準與行動限度
blocks.en: Topic A.1 — Setting Alert Levels and Action Limits

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 警報水準 vs 行動限度
blocks.en: Core Concept: Alert Level vs Action Limit

blocks.zh: Alert Level（警報水準）：根據歷史資料以統計方法設定的早期預警值。超過此值代表環境出現潛在不正常趨勢，需啟動調查，但不必然立即停止生產。
blocks.en: Alert Level: An early-warning value set statistically from historical data. Exceeding it signals a potential adverse trend in the environment and calls for an investigation, but does not necessarily mean production must stop immediately.

blocks.zh: Action Limit（行動限度）：超過此值代表環境管控可能已失效，必須立即採取行動（CAPA），並評估對批次的影響。
blocks.en: Action Limit: Exceeding this value indicates that environmental control may have failed. Action (CAPA) must be taken immediately and the impact on the batch assessed.

blocks.zh: 重要原則：Alert Level 必須低於 Action Limit，才能在問題惡化至需要行動之前提供緩衝時間。
blocks.en: Key principle: The alert level must be lower than the action limit so that there is a buffer of time before a problem worsens to the point that action is required.

blocks.zh: Grade A 特例：Grade A 區因任何微生物的存在都構成潛在風險，通常無法設定有意義的 Alert Level——任何菌落出現即觸發 Action 層級的回應。
blocks.en: Grade A exception: Because the presence of any microorganism in grade A is a potential risk, a meaningful alert level usually cannot be set. Any colony triggers an action-level response.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 警報與緊急疏散
blocks.en: Analogy: Alarm vs Emergency Evacuation

blocks.zh: 想像一棟大樓的火災安全系統：
blocks.en: Think of the fire safety system in a building:

blocks.zh: 煙霧偵測器響起（Alert Level）：某處有煙，保全人員前往確認，可能只是廚房蒸氣，但需要調查。大樓不需要立即疏散。
blocks.en: The smoke detector sounds (Alert Level): There is smoke somewhere. Security goes to check; it may only be steam from the kitchen, but it needs to be looked into. The building does not need to be evacuated immediately.

blocks.zh: 灑水頭啟動（Action Limit）：確認有火災，立即啟動緊急疏散，同時保全介入處理。
blocks.en: The sprinklers activate (Action Limit): A fire is confirmed, the emergency evacuation starts immediately, and security steps in to deal with it.

blocks.zh: EM 計劃的設計邏輯完全相同——建立「早期預警」讓你有時間反應，而不是等到問題失控才行動。
blocks.en: The logic of an EM program is exactly the same: build in an "early warning" so that you have time to react, rather than acting only after the problem is out of control.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — EU Annex 1 (2022) 新要求
blocks.en: Key Point: New Requirements in EU Annex 1 (2022)

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 2022 版本要求 Alert Level 的設定必須與設施的污染控制策略（CCS, Contamination Control Strategy）相連結。這意味著：
blocks.en: The 2022 revision of EU Annex 1 requires that the setting of alert levels be linked to the facility's Contamination Control Strategy (CCS). This means:

blocks.zh: 不能只是照抄監管機關公佈的參考值
blocks.en: You cannot simply copy reference values published by regulators

blocks.zh: 必須根據自家設施的歷史數據、製程特性、屏障技術（RABS/Isolator）設計
blocks.en: Levels must be based on your own facility's historical data, process characteristics and barrier technology design (RABS/isolator)

blocks.zh: 新設施可以用驗證數據或同類設施數據作為起始點，但必須定期根據實際數據更新
blocks.en: A new facility may use validation data or data from a comparable facility as a starting point, but must update the levels periodically based on actual data

blocks.zh: 這是一個重大的思維轉變：從「達標」到「主動管理」。
blocks.en: This is a major shift in mindset: from "meeting the limit" to "proactive management".

blocks.zh: 統計方法設定 Alert Level（TR-13 建議）
blocks.en: Statistical Methods for Setting Alert Levels (TR-13 Recommendation)

blocks.zh:
常用方法（PDA TR-13 Revised 2022）：

方法一：均值 + 標準差法
  Alert Level = Mean + 3×SD（適用常態分佈資料）

方法二：百分位數法
  Alert Level = 95th 或 97.5th 百分位數
  （適用計數型資料，如 CFU）

方法三：上控制限（UCL）
  使用 Poisson 或負二項分佈計算
  適用於稀疏計數（多數值為零）的環境資料

設定原則：
  • 至少需要 30 個以上的資料點
  • 排除異常值（已確認調查的超標事件）
  • 定期重新評估（建議每年或累積足夠資料時）
blocks.en:
Common methods (PDA TR-13 Revised 2022):

Method 1: Mean + standard deviation
  Alert Level = Mean + 3×SD (for normally distributed data)

Method 2: Percentile
  Alert Level = 95th or 97.5th percentile
  (for count data such as CFU)

Method 3: Upper control limit (UCL)
  Calculated using a Poisson or negative binomial distribution
  Suited to sparse count data (most values are zero) typical of environmental data

Principles:
  • At least 30 data points are needed
  • Exclude outliers (confirmed and investigated excursions)
  • Reassess periodically (annually, or once enough data have accumulated)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 新廠設定情境
blocks.en: Practical Application: Setting Limits in a New CDMO Facility

blocks.zh: 假設您的 CDMO 剛完成一條新的無菌充填線驗證，尚無歷史 EM 資料。依據 PtC-1 建議，您可以：
blocks.en: Suppose your CDMO has just completed validation of a new aseptic filling line and has no historical EM data yet. Following PtC-1, you could:

blocks.zh: 引用同廠區另一條已運作線的歷史均值作為起始 Alert Level
blocks.en: Use the historical mean from another operating line at the same site as the starting alert level

blocks.zh: 或使用驗證研究期間（至少 3 批 APS）收集的 EM 資料計算初始統計值
blocks.en: Or calculate initial statistics from EM data collected during the validation studies (at least 3 APS runs)

blocks.zh: 設定 6-12 個月的「磨合期」，持續收集數據後重新計算並更新
blocks.en: Set a 6-12 month "run-in period", continue collecting data, then recalculate and update the levels

blocks.zh: 確保 Alert Level 遠低於 EU Annex 1 表格中的行動限度參考值
blocks.en: Make sure alert levels are well below the reference action limits in the EU Annex 1 table

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果某 Grade B 監測點的歷史均值非常低（例如 0.1 CFU/m³），是否應該將 Alert Level 設為 0？這樣的設定有什麼實務問題？
blocks.en: If the historical mean at a grade B monitoring location is very low (for example, 0.1 CFU/m³), should the alert level be set to 0? What practical problems would such a setting create?

blocks.zh: 引進新型即時微粒偵測技術（如 RMM）後，其 Action Limit 應如何與傳統培養法比較？
blocks.en: After introducing a new real-time particle detection technology (such as an RMM), how should its action limit be compared with that of the traditional culture-based method?

blocks.zh: 為什麼說「Alert Limit 顯著高於趨勢數據」也是需要避免的？
blocks.en: Why is an alert limit that sits significantly above the trend data also something to avoid?

blocks.zh: Topic B.1 — EM Alert and Action Limits: Not Specifications | EM 限度非產品規格
blocks.en: Topic B.1 — EM Alert and Action Limits: Not Specifications

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — EM 限度 vs 產品規格的根本差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: How EM Limits Fundamentally Differ from Product Specifications

blocks.zh: 產品規格（Specification）：寫在 NDA/ANDA/MAA 等申請文件中，必須符合才能放行產品。超出即為 OOS（Out-of-Specification），觸發強制性調查程序，且通常導致批次拒絕。
blocks.en: Product specification: Stated in the filing (NDA/ANDA/MAA, etc.) and must be met for the product to be released. Failing it is an OOS (out-of-specification) result, which triggers a mandatory investigation and usually leads to batch rejection.

blocks.zh: EM 行動限度（Action Limit）：由廠商根據自身歷史數據設定的製程管控工具。超出觸發調查，但不自動等同於 OOS，也不必然導致批次拒絕。
blocks.en: EM action limit: A process control tool set by the manufacturer based on its own historical data. Exceeding it triggers an investigation, but is not automatically an OOS and does not necessarily lead to batch rejection.

blocks.zh: 關鍵邏輯：EM 超標 ≠ 產品污染。文件中明確指出：在 APS（無菌製程模擬）中可能出現 EM 超標但無培育失敗的情況，反之亦然。
blocks.en: Key logic: An EM excursion does not equal product contamination. The document states clearly that during an APS (aseptic process simulation) an EM excursion may occur without a media fill failure, and vice versa.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 交通警告標誌 vs 法律速限
blocks.en: Analogy: Advisory Road Signs vs Legal Speed Limits

blocks.zh: EM 限度就像高速公路上的「建議速度」標誌（如「彎道建議時速 60km」）：超過它不一定違法，但代表潛在風險增加，應該放慢速度並調查原因。
blocks.en: An EM limit is like an advisory speed sign on a highway (for example, "curve ahead, advised speed 60 km/h"): exceeding it is not necessarily illegal, but it signals increased risk, so you should slow down and find out why.

blocks.zh: 產品規格則像法定速限：超過就是違規，無論其他情況如何，都會有法律後果。
blocks.en: A product specification is like the legal speed limit: exceeding it is a violation, with legal consequences regardless of the circumstances.

blocks.zh: 混淆兩者的危險：若把 EM 限度當成規格，超標時就必須自動拒批，這會造成大量不必要的產品損失，且無法區分真正的品質風險與偶發的環境波動。
blocks.en: The danger of confusing the two: if EM limits were treated as specifications, every excursion would automatically force batch rejection. That would cause large, unnecessary product losses and would make it impossible to tell genuine quality risks from incidental environmental fluctuations.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Grade A 超標：行動但非規格
blocks.en: Key Point: Grade A Excursions: Action, but Not a Specification

blocks.zh: Grade A 區任何微生物的存在（即便只有 1 CFU）雖然技術上不是「OOS」，但：
blocks.en: The presence of any microorganism in grade A (even just 1 CFU) is not technically an "OOS", but:

blocks.zh: 必須進行完整調查
blocks.en: A full investigation is required

blocks.zh: 必須評估對所有相關批次的影響
blocks.en: The impact on all related batches must be assessed

blocks.zh: 批次放行決定需由 QP（歐盟）或負責人員基於調查結論做出
blocks.en: The batch release decision must be made by the QP (EU) or the responsible person based on the investigation conclusions

blocks.zh: 單一 Grade A 超標不自動導致拒批，但調查結果若顯示製程失控，則必須拒批
blocks.en: A single grade A excursion does not automatically lead to rejection, but if the investigation shows the process was out of control, the batch must be rejected

blocks.zh: 這個「非規格但必須行動」的邏輯是無菌製造管控哲學的核心。
blocks.en: This logic of "not a specification, yet action is required" is at the heart of the control philosophy for sterile manufacturing.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 批次放行決策情境
blocks.en: Practical Application: A Batch Release Decision Scenario

blocks.zh: 某批產品在充填期間，Grade B 空氣採樣結果為 12 CFU/m³（Action Limit = 10 CFU/m³）。此時：
blocks.en: During filling of a batch, a grade B air sample gives 12 CFU/m³ (action limit = 10 CFU/m³). In this case:

blocks.zh: 這不是 OOS，不觸發強制性 21 CFR 211.192 的 OOS 調查程序
blocks.en: This is not an OOS and does not trigger the mandatory OOS investigation procedure under 21 CFR 211.192

blocks.zh: 但必須啟動 EM 超標調查（偏差報告）
blocks.en: However, an EM excursion investigation (deviation report) must be started

blocks.zh: 調查需包含：菌株鑑定、HVAC 系統檢查、人員操作記錄、相鄰 Grade A 數據回顧
blocks.en: The investigation should include isolate identification, a check of the HVAC system, personnel activity records, and a review of data from the adjacent grade A area

blocks.zh: 若調查結論顯示無產品污染風險，批次可以在完整調查記錄的基礎上考慮放行
blocks.en: If the investigation concludes there is no risk of product contamination, the batch may be considered for release on the basis of a complete investigation record

blocks.zh: EM Action Limit 超標後，哪些情況下可以考慮放行批次？哪些情況下應該拒批？
blocks.en: After an EM action limit excursion, under what circumstances can batch release be considered, and under what circumstances should the batch be rejected?

blocks.zh: 如果一個 APS（媒體灌裝）出現培育失敗，但 EM 數據完全正常，這說明了什麼？應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: If an APS (media fill) has a contaminated unit but the EM data are completely normal, what does this indicate? What action should be taken?

blocks.zh: Grade A 的 Action Limit 為 <1 CFU/m³，如果檢測結果恰好是 1 CFU/m³，是否超標？
blocks.en: The action limit for grade A is <1 CFU/m³. If the result is exactly 1 CFU/m³, is that an excursion?

blocks.zh: Topic C — EM Relationship to Batch Release | 環境監測與批次放行的關係
blocks.en: Topic C — EM Relationship to Batch Release

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 風險導向的批次放行決策
blocks.en: Core Concept: Risk-Based Batch Release Decisions

blocks.zh: PtC-1 明確採取風險導向（Risk-Based）立場：EM 超標本身不等同於批次拒絕。批次放行決策應基於完整調查的綜合判斷，而非單一數字。
blocks.en: PtC-1 takes an explicitly risk-based position: an EM excursion in itself does not equal batch rejection. The batch release decision should rest on the combined judgment of a complete investigation, not on a single number.

blocks.zh: 必須納入批次放行審查的 EM 數據：
blocks.en: EM data that must be included in batch release review:

blocks.zh: Grade A 和 Grade B 的微生物監測數據（強制性）
blocks.en: Grade A and grade B microbial monitoring data (mandatory)

blocks.zh: Grade A 和 Grade B 的微粒監測數據（強制性）
blocks.en: Grade A and grade B particle monitoring data (mandatory)

blocks.zh: Grade C/D 數據（視情況考慮，非強制）
blocks.en: Grade C/D data (considered case by case, not mandatory)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 飛機黑盒子與事故調查
blocks.en: Analogy: The Aircraft Black Box and Accident Investigation

blocks.zh: EM 數據就像飛機的飛行記錄器（黑盒子）：它記錄了飛行過程中的環境狀態，但黑盒子顯示某個瞬間的數據異常，不代表飛機一定墜毀了。
blocks.en: EM data are like an aircraft's flight recorder (black box): they record the environmental conditions during the flight, but an anomaly at one moment in the black box data does not mean the aircraft necessarily crashed.

blocks.zh: 事故調查員需要結合黑盒子數據、機師報告、氣象記錄、機械檢查等所有資訊，才能得出最終結論。
blocks.en: Accident investigators must combine black box data, pilot reports, weather records, mechanical inspections and all other information before reaching a final conclusion.

blocks.zh: 同理，批次放行審查員需要結合 EM 數據、APS 記錄、人員操作日誌、維修記錄、菌株鑑定結果，才能做出科學決策。
blocks.en: Likewise, the batch release reviewer must combine EM data, APS records, personnel activity logs, maintenance records and isolate identification results to make a scientific decision.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 三種批次放行情境
blocks.en: Key Point: Three Batch Release Scenarios

blocks.zh: 情境一：EM 正常，無超標 → 常規批次放行審查，一般可放行。
blocks.en: Scenario 1: EM normal, no excursions → Routine batch release review; the batch can generally be released.

blocks.zh: 情境二：Grade C/D 超標，Grade A/B 正常 → 啟動調查，評估根本原因；若調查顯示無產品影響，可考慮放行，但需完整記錄。
blocks.en: Scenario 2: Grade C/D excursion, grade A/B normal → Start an investigation and assess the root cause; if the investigation shows no product impact, release can be considered, but it must be fully documented.

blocks.zh: 情境三：Grade A/B 超標 → 必須完整調查；若調查結論確認有產品污染風險（例如超標點直接鄰近開放容器），應考慮拒批或進行無菌性測試作為追加評估。
blocks.en: Scenario 3: Grade A/B excursion → A complete investigation is required; if the investigation confirms a risk of product contamination (for example, the excursion location is directly adjacent to open containers), rejection or sterility testing as an additional assessment should be considered.

blocks.zh: 如果批次放行時 EM 數據尚未完全取得（例如某些培養板仍在培養中），是否可以先放行？此時如何管理風險？
blocks.en: If EM data are not yet fully available at the time of batch release (for example, some plates are still incubating), can the batch be released first? How would you manage the risk in that case?

blocks.zh: 一個 Grade B 的 settle plate 顯示 6 CFU（Action Limit = 5 CFU），但 Grade A 數據完全正常，您會如何處理這個批次？
blocks.en: A grade B settle plate shows 6 CFU (action limit = 5 CFU), but the grade A data are completely normal. How would you handle this batch?

blocks.zh: 「原因-效果關係（cause-effect relationship）不自動存在」的邏輯，對 CDMO 的客戶溝通有何影響？如何向客戶解釋？
blocks.en: What does the logic that a "cause-effect relationship does not automatically exist" imply for CDMO customer communication? How would you explain it to a customer?

blocks.zh: Topic D — Location, Frequency, and Duration of EM | 監測地點、頻率與持續時間
blocks.en: Topic D — Location, Frequency, and Duration of EM

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — EM 計劃設計的三大維度
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Three Dimensions of EM Program Design

blocks.zh: 1. 地點（Location）：應選在最可能偵測到污染的位置，且需最靠近產品暴露區。Grade A 的關鍵採樣點包括：充填針頭上方、容器開口上方、停機位置等。
blocks.en: 1. Location: Locations should be chosen where contamination is most likely to be detected and as close as possible to where the product is exposed. Critical grade A sampling points include above the filling needles, above container openings, and stoppage positions.

blocks.zh: 2. 頻率（Frequency）：Grade A 需連續監測（微粒）；Grade B/C/D 頻率依風險評估決定。高風險操作（如人工介入）需增加臨時採樣。
blocks.en: 2. Frequency: Grade A requires continuous monitoring (particles); the frequency for grades B/C/D is determined by risk assessment. High-risk operations (such as manual interventions) call for additional ad hoc sampling.

blocks.zh: 3. 持續時間（Duration）：主動空氣採樣需定義取樣體積（通常 1 m³）；沉降碟有最長暴露時間限制（EU Annex 1 要求最多 4 小時）。表面採樣無持續時間概念，但時機（生產結束後）至關重要。
blocks.en: 3. Duration: Active air sampling requires a defined sample volume (typically 1 m³); settle plates have a maximum exposure time (EU Annex 1 requires no more than 4 hours). Surface sampling has no concept of duration, but timing (after the end of production) is critical.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — Grade A 的 24 小時監視器
blocks.en: Analogy: The 24-Hour Surveillance Camera for Grade A

blocks.zh: Grade A 的連續微粒監測就像監控攝影機（CCTV）：全程錄影，不是每小時才拍一張照片。
blocks.en: Continuous particle monitoring in grade A is like a CCTV camera: it records the whole time rather than taking one photo every hour.

blocks.zh: 為什麼？因為污染事件往往是瞬間發生的（例如人員介入、設備故障），如果監測不連續，可能完全錯過最關鍵的時刻。
blocks.en: Why? Because contamination events often happen in an instant (for example, an operator intervention or an equipment failure), and if monitoring is not continuous, the most critical moment may be missed entirely.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 進一步要求 Grade A 的微粒監測系統必須能夠實時（real-time）顯示並警報，而不只是事後讀取數據。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 (2022) further requires that the grade A particle monitoring system be able to display and alarm in real time, not merely allow data to be read afterwards.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — EM 介入本身是污染風險
blocks.en: Key Point: EM Interventions Are Themselves a Contamination Risk

blocks.zh: 這是一個容易被忽略的矛盾：為了證明環境受控，我們進行 EM；但 EM 的操作（人員進入、放置培養板、操作空氣採樣器）本身就是污染的來源。
blocks.en: This is a contradiction that is easy to overlook: we perform EM to demonstrate that the environment is under control, but the EM activities themselves (personnel entering, placing plates, operating air samplers) are a source of contamination.

blocks.zh: 實務應對：
blocks.en: Practical responses:

blocks.zh: Grade A 優先考慮無需人員介入的方法（如固定式連續微粒計數器）
blocks.en: For grade A, prefer methods that need no personnel intervention (such as fixed continuous particle counters)

blocks.zh: 沉降碟暴露量（數量×時間）應最小化
blocks.en: Settle plate exposure (number × time) should be minimized

blocks.zh: 表面採樣應在充填完成後、滅菌前進行，不在充填過程中進行
blocks.en: Surface sampling should be done after filling is complete and before sterilization, not during filling

blocks.zh: 取樣動作應由訓練有素的人員以標準化方式執行，以降低操作引入的變異
blocks.en: Sampling should be performed in a standardized way by well-trained personnel to reduce variability introduced by the operation

blocks.zh: 沉降碟 vs 主動空氣採樣的比較
blocks.en: Settle Plates vs Active Air Sampling

blocks.zh:
沉降碟（Settle Plate）：
  優點：簡單、成本低、可模擬粒子沉降到產品的風險
  缺點：無法定量（無採樣體積概念）
       長時間暴露有培養基乾燥問題
       EU Annex 1 限制最多 4 小時
  適用：作為主動採樣的補充，尤其是地面/工作台面評估

主動空氣採樣（Active Air Sampling）：
  優點：定量（CFU/m³）、時間彈性
  缺點：需要設備、採樣本身需人員操作
       流量和取樣體積影響回收率
  適用：Grade A/B 定量微生物監測主要方法

Grade A 要求：連續微粒監測（≥0.5 µm 和 ≥5.0 µm）
              微生物採樣每批次或每操作段
blocks.en:
Settle plates:
  Advantages: simple, low cost, can simulate the risk of particles settling onto product
  Disadvantages: not quantitative (no sample volume)
       drying of the medium during long exposure
       EU Annex 1 limits exposure to a maximum of 4 hours
  Use: as a supplement to active sampling, especially for floor/work surface assessment

Active air sampling:
  Advantages: quantitative (CFU/m³), flexible in time
  Disadvantages: needs equipment; sampling itself requires operator handling
       flow rate and sample volume affect recovery
  Use: the main method for quantitative microbial monitoring in grades A/B

Grade A requirements: continuous particle monitoring (≥0.5 µm and ≥5.0 µm)
              microbial sampling every batch or every operating session

blocks.zh: 使用隔離器（Isolator）進行無菌充填時，EM 計劃的設計與使用 RABS 有何不同？哪些監測點可以省略或調整？
blocks.en: When an isolator is used for aseptic filling, how does the EM program design differ from that for RABS? Which monitoring points can be omitted or adjusted?

blocks.zh: 如果一條充填線一天生產三個班次，Grade B 的 EM 應以何種頻率採樣才算足夠？
blocks.en: If a filling line runs three shifts a day, what sampling frequency for grade B EM is sufficient?

blocks.zh: 為什麼表面採樣必須在「生產結束後」而非「生產過程中」進行？如果違反這個原則會有什麼風險？
blocks.en: Why must surface sampling be done "after the end of production" rather than "during production"? What risks arise if this principle is violated?

blocks.zh: Topic E — Investigation and Documentation of EM Excursions | 超標調查與記錄
blocks.en: Topic E — Investigation and Documentation of EM Excursions

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — EM 超標調查的五個核心要素
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five Core Elements of an EM Excursion Investigation

blocks.zh: PtC-1 列出的調查記錄要素，對應了 GMP 調查的標準架構：
blocks.en: The investigation record elements listed in PtC-1 correspond to the standard structure of a GMP investigation:

blocks.zh: 問題描述（What）：哪個採樣點，哪種方法，結果數值
blocks.en: Problem description (What): Which sampling location, which method, what result

blocks.zh: 可能原因（Why）：根本原因分析（RCA），使用魚骨圖等工具
blocks.en: Probable cause (Why): Root cause analysis (RCA), using tools such as a fishbone diagram

blocks.zh: 行動計劃（How）：CAPA 清單，包含責任人和完成時限
blocks.en: Action plan (How): A list of CAPAs, including owners and due dates

blocks.zh: 責任人（Who）：每個行動步驟均有指定負責人
blocks.en: Responsibility (Who): A named owner for every action step

blocks.zh: 有效性評估（Does it work?）：CAPA 完成後的追蹤驗證
blocks.en: Effectiveness check (Does it work?): Follow-up verification after the CAPA is completed

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — EM 超標調查決策樹
blocks.en: Analogy: The EM Excursion Investigation as a Decision Tree

blocks.zh: 想像 EM 超標調查就像醫師的診斷流程：
blocks.en: Think of an EM excursion investigation as a physician's diagnostic process:

blocks.zh: 症狀出現（超標數據）→ 先排除假陽性（採樣錯誤？培養問題？）
blocks.en: Symptom appears (excursion data) → first rule out a false positive (sampling error? culture problem?)

blocks.zh: 初步評估 → 超標發生在哪個 Grade？哪個時間點？
blocks.en: Initial assessment → In which grade did the excursion occur? At what time?

blocks.zh: 鑑別診斷 → 菌株鑑定：是皮膚菌（人員）？水菌（管路）？孢子菌（環境持久性問題）？
blocks.en: Differential diagnosis → Isolate identification: is it a skin organism (personnel)? A water organism (piping)? A spore-former (an environmental persistence problem)?

blocks.zh: 病因追蹤 → 查閱當日操作日誌、HVAC 記錄、人員 gowning 記錄
blocks.en: Tracing the cause → Review that day's operating logs, HVAC records and gowning records

blocks.zh: 治療方案 → CAPA：清潔消毒加強、人員培訓、設備維修
blocks.en: Treatment plan → CAPA: enhanced cleaning and disinfection, personnel training, equipment repair

blocks.zh: 康復追蹤 → 後續 EM 數據確認 CAPA 有效
blocks.en: Follow-up → Subsequent EM data confirm that the CAPA is effective

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 調查的時間性與範圍延伸
blocks.en: Key Point: Timeline and Extended Scope of the Investigation

blocks.zh: 時間性：EM 超標調查不能只看發現超標的那一個時間點。需要回顧相鄰批次、相鄰時段的趨勢，以確認是偶發事件還是系統性問題。
blocks.en: Timeline: An EM excursion investigation cannot look only at the single point in time when the excursion was found. Trends in adjacent batches and adjacent time periods must be reviewed to determine whether it is an isolated event or a systemic problem.

blocks.zh: 空間延伸：Grade A/B 超標時，必須評估對同一時間段在該設施生產的其他批次（包括不同產品）的影響。
blocks.en: Spatial extension: When a grade A/B excursion occurs, the impact on other batches (including different products) manufactured in the facility during the same period must be assessed.

blocks.zh: GMP 文件要求：調查報告必須是正式的 GMP 記錄，可供監管機構審查。不充分的調查記錄是 FDA 483 觀察項目的常見來源。
blocks.en: GMP documentation requirement: The investigation report must be a formal GMP record that can be reviewed by regulators. Inadequate investigation records are a common source of FDA 483 observations.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 調查報告的常見缺失（FDA 483 觀察項目）
blocks.en: Practical Application: Common Deficiencies in Investigation Reports (FDA 483 Observations)

blocks.zh: 根本原因分析不足（僅記錄「偶發事件」，未深入探討）
blocks.en: Inadequate root cause analysis (merely recording "isolated event" without digging deeper)

blocks.zh: CAPA 缺乏具體時限和責任人
blocks.en: CAPAs without specific due dates and owners

blocks.zh: 未評估對同期生產批次的影響
blocks.en: No assessment of the impact on batches produced during the same period

blocks.zh: 未追蹤 CAPA 的有效性（無 follow-up EM 數據）
blocks.en: No follow-up on CAPA effectiveness (no follow-up EM data)

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析缺失（未與歷史數據比較）
blocks.en: No trend analysis (no comparison with historical data)

blocks.zh: 在 EM 調查中發現超標菌株為 Bacillus 孢子菌（難以被一般消毒劑殺滅），您的 CAPA 計劃應包含哪些特殊措施？
blocks.en: If the excursion isolate in an EM investigation is a Bacillus spore-former (hard to kill with ordinary disinfectants), what special measures should your CAPA plan include?

blocks.zh: 如果相同採樣點連續三次超標，根本原因調查的重點應從哪裡著手？
blocks.en: If the same sampling location exceeds the limit three times in a row, where should the root cause investigation focus?

blocks.zh: EM 超標事件發生在週五下午，批次準備週一放行。您需要在週末完成哪些評估才能做出放行決定？
blocks.en: An EM excursion occurs on a Friday afternoon, and the batch is scheduled for release on Monday. What assessments must you complete over the weekend before making the release decision?

blocks.zh: Topic F — Room Classification for Terminally Sterilized Products | 終端滅菌產品的房間分級
blocks.en: Topic F — Room Classification for Terminally Sterilized Products

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 終端滅菌 vs 無菌充填的環境要求差異
blocks.en: Core Concept: Environmental Requirements for Terminal Sterilization vs Aseptic Filling

blocks.zh: 無菌充填（Aseptic Filling）：無滅菌步驟補救，充填區需要 Grade A 環境，對 EM 有最嚴格要求。
blocks.en: Aseptic filling: There is no sterilization step to compensate for failures, so the filling zone requires a grade A environment and the strictest EM requirements.

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌（Terminal Sterilization）：最後一道滅菌步驟（PNSU ≤10⁻⁶）提供了強大的安全網，因此充填區僅需 Grade C（通常），配製區僅需 Grade D。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization: The final sterilization step (PNSU ≤10⁻⁶) provides a strong safety net, so the filling zone typically needs only grade C and the preparation zone only grade D.

blocks.zh: 但仍需管控！原因：如果充填前的生物負荷（Bioburden）過高，即使 D-value 正常的高壓滅菌也可能無法達到 PNSU ≤10⁻⁶，尤其對耐熱孢子菌而言。
blocks.en: But control is still needed. Why: If the pre-fill bioburden is too high, even an autoclave cycle with a normal D-value may fail to achieve a PNSU ≤10⁻⁶, especially for heat-resistant spore-formers.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 微波爐重新加熱 vs 無菌手術
blocks.en: Analogy: Reheating in a Microwave vs Aseptic Surgery

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌就像用微波爐重新加熱食物：即使準備過程不夠乾淨，最終加熱步驟可以殺死大多數細菌。但如果食物已經腐爛到極點（生物負荷極高），微波爐也無法完全補救。
blocks.en: Terminal sterilization is like reheating food in a microwave: even if the preparation was not very clean, the final heating step can kill most bacteria. But if the food is already badly spoiled (extremely high bioburden), the microwave cannot fully rescue it.

blocks.zh: 無菌充填就像外科手術：整個過程必須維持無菌，因為沒有最後一道「滅菌」步驟可以補救任何失誤。
blocks.en: Aseptic filling is like surgery: sterility must be maintained throughout, because there is no final "sterilization" step to correct any mistake.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼終端滅菌產品的環境要求雖然不如無菌充填嚴格，但仍然需要系統性的微生物管控。
blocks.en: This is why the environmental requirements for terminally sterilized products, although less strict than for aseptic filling, still call for systematic microbial control.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 生物負荷管控是關鍵防線
blocks.en: Key Point: Bioburden Control Is the Key Line of Defense

blocks.zh: 對終端滅菌產品而言，生物負荷（Bioburden）測試是最重要的製程管控指標之一：
blocks.en: For terminally sterilized products, bioburden testing is one of the most important process control indicators:

blocks.zh: 必須在過濾器之前（upstream）和充填後（presterilized）兩個點測試
blocks.en: It must be tested at two points: upstream of the filter and after filling (presterilization)

blocks.zh: Action Limit 的設定需與滅菌週期設計相符
blocks.en: Action limits must be set consistent with the sterilization cycle design

blocks.zh: 耐熱孢子數量（moist-heat-resistant spore count）需特別關注
blocks.en: The count of moist-heat-resistant spores requires special attention

blocks.zh: 配製到滅菌之間的時間（hold time）需有最大時限，超過需重新評估
blocks.en: The time between preparation and sterilization (hold time) needs a maximum limit, and exceeding it requires reassessment

blocks.zh: 過濾器完整性測試（IFT/FFT）是批次放行的關鍵條件
blocks.en: Filter integrity testing (IFT/FFT) is a key condition for batch release

blocks.zh: 如果終端滅菌產品的充填線安裝在一個 Grade B 環境中（比要求更嚴格），這有什麼商業利弊？
blocks.en: If the filling line for a terminally sterilized product is installed in a grade B environment (stricter than required), what are the commercial pros and cons?

blocks.zh: 滅菌前生物負荷超出 Action Limit 時，是否可以延長滅菌時間來補救？這樣做有什麼風險？
blocks.en: When presterilization bioburden exceeds the action limit, can the sterilization time be extended to compensate? What are the risks of doing so?

blocks.zh: 配製用水（WFI）的微生物控制為什麼對終端滅菌產品特別重要？
blocks.en: Why is microbial control of the water used for preparation (WFI) especially important for terminally sterilized products?

blocks.zh: Topic G — Cleaning and Disinfection Program for Grade A and B | 清潔與消毒計劃
blocks.en: Topic G — Cleaning and Disinfection Program for Grade A and B

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 消毒計劃的層次架構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Tiered Structure of a Disinfection Program

blocks.zh: 第一層：清潔（Cleaning） — 必須先清潔才能有效消毒。有機物（蛋白質、油脂）會保護微生物免受消毒劑作用。
blocks.en: Tier 1: Cleaning — Cleaning must come first for disinfection to be effective. Organic matter (proteins, grease) protects microorganisms from the disinfectant.

blocks.zh: 第二層：一般消毒劑（General Disinfectant） — 殺滅蔬菌（Vegetative bacteria）和真菌，如 70% 異丙醇（IPA）、季銨鹽（Quats）。
blocks.en: Tier 2: General disinfectant — Kills vegetative bacteria and fungi, for example 70% isopropyl alcohol (IPA) and quaternary ammonium compounds (quats).

blocks.zh: 第三層：孢子殺滅劑（Sporicide） — 殺滅 Bacillus 等孢子菌，如過氧化氫（H₂O₂）氣體、過氧乙酸（Peracetic acid）。EU Annex 1 (2022) 明確要求 Grade A/B 必須定期使用孢子殺滅劑。
blocks.en: Tier 3: Sporicide — Kills spore-formers such as Bacillus, for example hydrogen peroxide (H₂O₂) vapor and peracetic acid. EU Annex 1 (2022) explicitly requires that a sporicide be used regularly in grades A/B.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 消毒劑輪替如同抗生素輪替
blocks.en: Analogy: Disinfectant Rotation Is Like Antibiotic Rotation

blocks.zh: 長期使用同一種消毒劑，環境中的微生物可能逐漸產生適應性或耐受性（雖然與抗生素耐藥機制不完全相同，但同樣的後果：效力降低）。
blocks.en: With long-term use of the same disinfectant, microorganisms in the environment may gradually develop adaptation or tolerance (the mechanism is not exactly the same as antibiotic resistance, but the consequence is the same: reduced efficacy).

blocks.zh: 就像醫院的感染管控計劃會輪替使用不同抗生素來避免耐藥菌的產生，無菌製造設施也應定期輪替不同類別的消毒劑，確保廣譜有效性。
blocks.en: Just as a hospital's infection control program rotates different antibiotics to avoid resistant organisms, a sterile manufacturing facility should rotate disinfectants of different classes on a regular basis to ensure broad-spectrum effectiveness.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 明確規定消毒劑輪替的概念，並要求每種消毒劑均需進行有效性驗證（對場地分離菌株的驗證尤為重要）。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 (2022) explicitly sets out the concept of disinfectant rotation and requires each disinfectant to be validated for effectiveness (validation against site isolates is especially important).

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — EU Annex 1 (2022) 對消毒的新要求
blocks.en: Key Point: New Disinfection Requirements in EU Annex 1 (2022)

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 相比舊版有幾個重要的清潔消毒新要求：
blocks.en: Compared with the previous version, EU Annex 1 (2022) has several important new cleaning and disinfection requirements:

blocks.zh: 孢子殺滅劑（Sporicide）必須定期使用於 Grade A 和 Grade B，不再只是「建議」
blocks.en: A sporicide must be used regularly in grade A and grade B; this is no longer just a "recommendation"

blocks.zh: 消毒劑必須針對設施自身的環境菌株（site isolates）進行有效性驗證，不能只依賴通用數據
blocks.en: Disinfectant effectiveness must be validated against the facility's own environmental isolates (site isolates), rather than relying only on generic data

blocks.zh: 消毒劑的有效性必須與 CCS（污染控制策略）整合考量
blocks.en: Disinfectant effectiveness must be considered in an integrated way with the CCS (contamination control strategy)

blocks.zh: 對消毒後的接觸時間（contact time/dwell time）需明確規定並遵守
blocks.en: The contact time (dwell time) after application must be clearly specified and observed

blocks.zh: 消毒效力要求總結
blocks.en: Summary of Disinfectant Efficacy Requirements

blocks.zh:
PtC-1 消毒劑效力最低要求：

對細菌孢子（Bacterial Spores）：
  ≥ 2 log 殺滅（在代表性表面）
  ≥ 1 log 殺滅（在 1-5 分鐘接觸時間內）

對蔬菌和真菌（Vegetative bacteria & Fungi）：
  ≥ 3 log 殺滅（在代表性表面）
  ≥ 1 log 殺滅（在 1-5 分鐘接觸時間內）

驗證對象必須包含：
  ✓ 法定標準菌株（Compendial organisms）
  ✓ 設施自身分離菌株（Site isolates）
  ✓ 設施實際使用的表面材質
  ✓ 設施實際的應用程序（抹布/噴霧/泡沫）

注意：過度用力的擦拭動作可能誇大消毒劑效力
（PtC-1 明確警告）
blocks.en:
Minimum disinfectant efficacy requirements in PtC-1:

Against bacterial spores:
  ≥ 2 log reduction (on representative surfaces)
  ≥ 1 log reduction (within a 1-5 minute contact time)

Against vegetative bacteria & fungi:
  ≥ 3 log reduction (on representative surfaces)
  ≥ 1 log reduction (within a 1-5 minute contact time)

Validation must include:
  ✓ Compendial organisms
  ✓ Site isolates
  ✓ The surface materials actually used in the facility
  ✓ The application methods actually used in the facility (wipe/spray/foam)

Note: Overly vigorous wiping may overstate disinfectant efficacy
(explicitly cautioned in PtC-1)

blocks.zh: 您設施的 EM 趨勢顯示 Grade B 出現 Bacillus 孢子菌的比例升高，您會如何調整消毒計劃？
blocks.en: EM trends at your facility show a rising proportion of Bacillus spore-formers in grade B. How would you adjust the disinfection program?

blocks.zh: 消毒劑驗證通常使用供應商提供的數據是否足夠？PtC-1 對此有何立場？
blocks.en: Is it sufficient to rely on data provided by the supplier for disinfectant validation? What is PtC-1's position on this?

blocks.zh: 如果清潔人員在擦拭消毒時用力過猛（vigorous wiping），驗證數據會如何受影響？這對設定例行操作規程有何啟示？
blocks.en: If cleaning staff wipe too vigorously during disinfection, how are the validation data affected? What does this imply for setting routine operating procedures?

blocks.zh: Topic H — Identification of Environmental Isolates | 環境菌株鑑定策略
blocks.en: Topic H — Identification of Environmental Isolates

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 鑑定層次與觸發條件
blocks.en: Core Concept: Identification Tiers and Triggers

blocks.zh: Table H-1 建立了一個「比例原則」的鑑定策略——分析深度與風險程度相匹配：
blocks.en: Table H-1 establishes a "proportionality" approach to identification, with the depth of analysis matched to the level of risk:

blocks.zh: 形態學（Gram stain + 菌落形態）：Grade C/D 警報水準超標的初步篩選
blocks.en: Morphology (Gram stain + colony morphology): Initial screening for grade C/D alert level excursions

blocks.zh: 菌種鑑定（Species level）：Grade C/D 行動限度超標；Grade A/B 的任何超標；水及賦形劑的超標
blocks.en: Species-level identification: Grade C/D action limit excursions; any excursion in grade A/B; excursions in water and excipients

blocks.zh: 菌株鑑定（Strain level）：重大失敗事件（APS 失敗、無菌性測試失敗）；顯著不良趨勢
blocks.en: Strain-level identification: Major failure events (APS failure, sterility test failure); significant adverse trends

blocks.zh: 菌株鑑定方法包括：脈衝場膠電泳（PFGE）、MALDI-TOF MS、16S rRNA 定序、全基因組定序（WGS）。
blocks.en: Strain typing methods include pulsed-field gel electrophoresis (PFGE), MALDI-TOF MS, 16S rRNA sequencing and whole genome sequencing (WGS).

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 警方犯罪調查的層次
blocks.en: Analogy: The Tiers of a Police Criminal Investigation

blocks.zh: 菌株鑑定就像警方的犯罪偵查：
blocks.en: Strain identification is like a police criminal investigation:

blocks.zh: 形態學 = 目擊者描述（「高個子男性」）：快速粗略，無法確認身份
blocks.en: Morphology = an eyewitness description ("a tall man"): quick and rough, cannot confirm identity

blocks.zh: 菌種鑑定 = 照片比對（「和嫌疑人同類型外觀」）：更精確，但仍可能有多人符合
blocks.en: Species identification = comparing photographs ("looks like the suspect's type"): more precise, but several people may still match

blocks.zh: 菌株鑑定 = DNA 指紋比對：可確認「就是這個人」，並追溯來源
blocks.en: Strain identification = DNA fingerprint matching: can confirm "this is the person" and trace the source

blocks.zh: 當 APS 失敗或產品無菌性測試失敗時，必須進行「DNA 指紋比對」（菌株鑑定），才能確認污染源並設計精準 CAPA。
blocks.en: When an APS or a product sterility test fails, "DNA fingerprint matching" (strain identification) must be performed to confirm the source of contamination and design a targeted CAPA.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 建立設施菌株資料庫
blocks.en: Key Point: Building a Facility Isolate Database

blocks.zh: 為什麼要建立 user-database（設施菌株資料庫）？
blocks.en: Why build a user database (a facility isolate database)?

blocks.zh: 了解設施的「正常菌相」（typical flora），才能偵測到異常
blocks.en: Knowing the facility's "typical flora" is what makes it possible to detect abnormalities

blocks.zh: 新菌種出現 → 可能有新的污染源（新原材料、新人員、施工等）
blocks.en: A new species appears → there may be a new contamination source (new raw materials, new personnel, construction, etc.)

blocks.zh: 特定菌株反覆出現 → 提示設施中存在持續性污染點（niche/reservoir）
blocks.en: A particular strain recurs → suggests a persistent contamination point (niche/reservoir) in the facility

blocks.zh: 消毒後孢子菌比例上升 → 提示消毒計劃對孢子菌效力不足
blocks.en: The proportion of spore-formers rises after disinfection → suggests the disinfection program is not effective enough against spore-formers

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 新增要求：即使是 Grade C/D 的正常監測（非超標），也應定期進行菌株鑑定以建立並維護菌相理解。
blocks.en: New requirement in EU Annex 1 (2022): Even for routine monitoring of grade C/D (without excursions), isolates should be identified periodically to establish and maintain an understanding of the flora.

blocks.zh: 常見環境菌株與污染源指示關係
blocks.en: Common Environmental Isolates and What They Indicate About Contamination Sources

blocks.zh:
菌種 → 典型來源 / 意義

Staphylococcus spp.   → 人員皮膚 / gowning 失效
Micrococcus spp.      → 人員皮膚、毛髮
Bacillus spp.         → 環境孢子 / 消毒劑效力不足
Aspergillus spp.      → 空氣（過濾器失效？）/ 外部帶入
Pseudomonas spp.      → 水系統 / 表面潮濕點
Burkholderia spp.     → 水系統 / 消毒劑污染
Penicillium spp.      → 原材料 / 外包裝帶入
Candida spp.          → 人員皮膚 / 黏膜

關鍵原則：
菌種鑑定提供「來源假說」，需結合
現場調查（操作記錄、設備狀態、物料來源）
才能確認根本原因。
blocks.en:
Organism → Typical source / significance

Staphylococcus spp.   → personnel skin / gowning failure
Micrococcus spp.      → personnel skin, hair
Bacillus spp.         → environmental spores / inadequate disinfectant efficacy
Aspergillus spp.      → air (filter failure?) / brought in from outside
Pseudomonas spp.      → water systems / wet surfaces
Burkholderia spp.     → water systems / contaminated disinfectant
Penicillium spp.      → raw materials / outer packaging
Candida spp.          → personnel skin / mucous membranes

Key principle:
Species identification provides a "source hypothesis" that must be combined with
on-site investigation (operating records, equipment status, material sources)
before the root cause can be confirmed.

blocks.zh: APS（媒體灌裝）出現一個培育失敗，分離到 Staphylococcus epidermidis，同時 EM 數據正常。您的調查重點應集中在哪裡？
blocks.en: An APS (media fill) has one contaminated unit, with Staphylococcus epidermidis isolated, while the EM data are normal. Where should your investigation focus?

blocks.zh: 如果 Grade B 監測連續三個月都出現 Pseudomonas 菌，但每次都在 Action Limit 以下，這代表什麼？應採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: If grade B monitoring shows Pseudomonas for three consecutive months, each time below the action limit, what does this mean? What action should be taken?

blocks.zh: MALDI-TOF MS 與傳統生化鑑定方法在結果比較上有什麼注意事項？（提示：PtC-1 中有相關警語）
blocks.en: What should be kept in mind when comparing MALDI-TOF MS results with those of traditional biochemical identification methods? (Hint: PtC-1 contains a relevant caution.)

blocks.zh: Topic I — Growth-Promotion Testing of EM Media | 培養基生長促進測試
blocks.en: Topic I — Growth-Promotion Testing of EM Media

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 培養基本身也需要品質管控
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Media Themselves Also Need Quality Control

blocks.zh: EM 結果的可靠性完全依賴培養基的品質。如果培養基無法有效回收微生物，則所有 EM 數據都是虛假的安全感。
blocks.en: The reliability of EM results depends entirely on the quality of the media. If the media cannot recover microorganisms effectively, all the EM data give only a false sense of security.

blocks.zh: Growth-Promotion Test（生長促進測試）的目的：確認培養基能夠支持目標微生物的生長，且回收率符合要求（通常為 70%-200% 的接種量回收，或 USP 要求的計數標準）。
blocks.en: Purpose of the growth-promotion test (GPT): To confirm that the medium supports the growth of the target microorganisms with acceptable recovery (typically 70%-200% recovery of the inoculum, or the count criteria required by USP).

blocks.zh: 測試時機：
blocks.en: When to test:

blocks.zh: 每個新批號（lot）收貨時
blocks.en: Upon receipt of each new lot

blocks.zh: 供應商允許的情況下可進行 Skip-lot testing
blocks.en: Skip-lot testing where the supplier allows it

blocks.zh: 運輸後（如懷疑溫度超標）
blocks.en: After transport (if a temperature excursion is suspected)

blocks.zh: 媒體製備後（in-house 製備）
blocks.en: After media preparation (for in-house prepared media)

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 培養基就像偵測器的電池
blocks.en: Analogy: Culture Media Are Like the Batteries in a Detector

blocks.zh: 想像您的 EM 計劃是一個火災偵測系統，培養基就是偵測器裡的電池。如果電池沒電（培養基失效），偵測器永遠不會響——不是因為沒有火災，而是因為偵測器根本無法工作。
blocks.en: Imagine your EM program is a fire detection system and the culture medium is the battery in the detector. If the battery is dead (the medium has failed), the detector never sounds, not because there is no fire, but because the detector cannot work at all.

blocks.zh: 定期的 Growth-Promotion Test 就是「定期更換電池並測試偵測器功能」，確保 EM 系統處於功能性狀態。
blocks.en: Regular growth-promotion testing is like "regularly replacing the batteries and testing the detector function", ensuring the EM system remains in a functional state.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — Skip-Lot Testing 的合理化
blocks.en: Key Point: Justifying Skip-Lot Testing

blocks.zh: 並非每一個批號都必須進行 100% 的 GPT。PtC-1 允許在以下條件下進行 Skip-lot testing（部分批次測試）：
blocks.en: Not every lot must undergo 100% GPT. PtC-1 allows skip-lot testing (testing only some lots) under the following conditions:

blocks.zh: 供應商有健全的品質體系（QMS）
blocks.en: The supplier has a sound quality system (QMS)

blocks.zh: 定期對供應商進行稽核
blocks.en: The supplier is audited regularly

blocks.zh: 有效的溝通/通知政策（供應商必須主動通知任何製造變更）
blocks.en: An effective communication/notification policy (the supplier must proactively notify any manufacturing change)

blocks.zh: 有長期良好的供應商使用記錄
blocks.en: A long record of good performance with the supplier

blocks.zh: 風險管控：即使進行 Skip-lot，仍需要統計計劃（如每 N 批測試一批）並記錄合理化依據。
blocks.en: Risk control: Even with skip-lot testing, a statistical plan (for example, testing one lot in every N lots) is still needed, and the rationale must be documented.

blocks.zh: 如果 GPT 結果顯示某批培養基的回收率偏低（例如只有 50%），已經用這批培養基採集的 EM 樣品結果應如何處理？
blocks.en: If GPT shows low recovery for a lot of media (for example, only 50%), how should the results of EM samples already collected with that lot be handled?

blocks.zh: 除了法定標準菌株（Compendial organisms），為什麼可能需要加入設施自身分離菌株進行 GPT？
blocks.en: Besides compendial organisms, why might site isolates also need to be added to GPT?

blocks.zh: 培養基從供應商到使用之間的運輸過程（transportation route）可能造成哪些問題？如何驗證？
blocks.en: What problems can occur during transportation of media from the supplier to the point of use? How can this be validated?

blocks.zh: Topic J — Incubation Temperatures for EM Samples | EM 樣品培養溫度
blocks.en: Topic J — Incubation Temperatures for EM Samples

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 為什麼培養溫度有爭議？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Incubation Temperature Controversial?

blocks.zh: 不同的微生物有不同的最適生長溫度：
blocks.en: Different microorganisms have different optimal growth temperatures:

blocks.zh: 嗜溫菌（Mesophiles）如大多數細菌：最適 30-37°C
blocks.en: Mesophiles, such as most bacteria: Optimum 30-37°C

blocks.zh: 嗜冷菌（Psychrotrophs）如某些環境菌：最適 20-25°C
blocks.en: Psychrotrophs, such as some environmental organisms: Optimum 20-25°C

blocks.zh: 酵母菌和黴菌：最適 22-25°C，高溫（>30°C）可能抑制生長
blocks.en: Yeasts and molds: Optimum 22-25°C; higher temperatures (>30°C) may inhibit growth

blocks.zh: PtC-1 的立場：單一溫度（20-35°C 範圍內任何一點）對大多數製造環境已足夠，但需要根據設施的環境菌相評估是否需要雙溫培養。
blocks.en: PtC-1's position: A single temperature (any point within the 20-35°C range) is sufficient for most manufacturing environments, but whether dual-temperature incubation is needed should be assessed against the facility's environmental flora.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 雙溫培養 vs 單溫培養
blocks.en: Analogy: Dual-Temperature vs Single-Temperature Incubation

blocks.zh: 培養溫度的選擇就像設定食物保存溫度：
blocks.en: Choosing an incubation temperature is like choosing a food storage temperature:

blocks.zh: 如果你只用 37°C 的溫箱培養，就像只在夏天（高溫）測試食品安全——會看到嗜溫菌，但可能錯過在 4°C 冰箱中也能生長的嗜冷菌。
blocks.en: If you incubate only at 37°C, it is like testing food safety only in summer (high temperature): you will see the mesophiles but may miss psychrotrophs that can also grow in a 4°C refrigerator.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 歷史上建議雙溫培養（20-25°C 培養後再 30-35°C），以確保同時捕捉酵母/黴菌和細菌。PtC-1 採取更靈活的立場——只要科學評估支持，單一溫度也可以接受。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 historically recommended dual-temperature incubation (20-25°C followed by 30-35°C) to capture both yeasts/molds and bacteria. PtC-1 takes a more flexible position: a single temperature is also acceptable as long as it is supported by scientific assessment.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — EU Annex 1 (2022) 與 PDA PtC-1 的異同
blocks.en: Key Point: EU Annex 1 (2022) vs PDA PtC-1: Similarities and Differences

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 立場：推薦雙溫培養（先 20-25°C 培養約 5 天，再 30-35°C 培養約 2 天），以確保黴菌和細菌均被有效回收。這是一個更保守的方法。
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 (2022) position: Recommends dual-temperature incubation (about 5 days at 20-25°C, then about 2 days at 30-35°C) to ensure that both molds and bacteria are recovered effectively. This is the more conservative approach.

blocks.zh: PDA PtC-1 立場：認為單一溫度在大多數情況下已足夠，但需要科學評估支持。採用非選擇性培養基（如 SCDA）在 20-35°C 之間的任一溫度培養 3-7 天，是科學上合理的。
blocks.en: PDA PtC-1 position: Considers a single temperature sufficient in most cases, provided it is supported by scientific assessment. Incubating a nonselective medium (such as SCDA) at any temperature between 20-35°C for 3-7 days is scientifically justifiable.

blocks.zh: 實務建議：如果您的產品在歐盟市場銷售，建議採用 EU Annex 1 的雙溫培養方案，以滿足監管預期。
blocks.en: Practical recommendation: If your product is sold in the EU market, adopt the EU Annex 1 dual-temperature scheme to meet regulatory expectations.

blocks.zh: 培養條件設計決策框架
blocks.en: Decision Framework for Designing Incubation Conditions

blocks.zh:
步驟一：了解設施環境菌相
  → 對現有 EM 分離菌株進行溫度耐受性評估
  → 查看歷史數據：是否有酵母/黴菌超標？

步驟二：選擇培養基
  → SCDA（Soybean Casein Digest Agar）= 最通用選擇
  → Sabouraud Dextrose Agar（SDA）= 若需強化酵母/黴菌回收

步驟三：選擇培養條件
  選項A（PDA TR-13 / USP 建議）：
    30-35°C × 3-5 天（細菌優先）
    + 20-25°C × 5-7 天（酵母/黴菌）

  選項B（EU Annex 1 2022）：
    先 20-25°C × ~5 天 → 再 30-35°C × ~2 天

  選項C（單一溫度，需科學評估支持）：
    22-25°C × 5-7 天

步驟四：生長促進測試（GPT）驗證所選條件
  → 確認所選培養基+溫度能回收目標菌株
blocks.en:
Step 1: Understand the facility's environmental flora
  → Assess the temperature tolerance of existing EM isolates
  → Review historical data: have there been any yeast/mold excursions?

Step 2: Select the medium
  → SCDA (Soybean Casein Digest Agar) = the most versatile choice
  → Sabouraud Dextrose Agar (SDA) = if enhanced yeast/mold recovery is needed

Step 3: Select the incubation conditions
  Option A (PDA TR-13 / USP recommendation):
    30-35°C × 3-5 days (bacteria first)
    + 20-25°C × 5-7 days (yeasts/molds)

  Option B (EU Annex 1 2022):
    20-25°C × ~5 days first → then 30-35°C × ~2 days

  Option C (single temperature, requires scientific justification):
    22-25°C × 5-7 days

Step 4: Verify the selected conditions by growth-promotion testing (GPT)
  → Confirm that the selected medium + temperature recovers the target organisms

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 客戶監管市場差異
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Customers in Different Regulatory Markets

blocks.zh: CDMO 通常同時服務多個市場的客戶。以 EM 培養溫度為例：
blocks.en: A CDMO usually serves customers in several markets at once. Taking EM incubation temperature as an example:

blocks.zh: 美國 FDA 市場：USP <1116> 允許靈活的培養條件，科學評估支持即可
blocks.en: US FDA market: USP <1116> allows flexible incubation conditions, provided they are supported by scientific assessment

blocks.zh: 歐盟 EMA 市場：EU Annex 1 (2022) 傾向雙溫培養，監查員可能期待看到
blocks.en: EU EMA market: EU Annex 1 (2022) favors dual-temperature incubation, and inspectors may expect to see it

blocks.zh: 日本 PMDA 市場：JPE 與 USP 接近，但監查員有時有更嚴格的期待
blocks.en: Japan PMDA market: The JP is close to USP, but inspectors sometimes have stricter expectations

blocks.zh: 建議：在驗證階段就建立能滿足最嚴格要求的培養條件（EU Annex 1），並在法規文件中說明選擇依據，以應對多市場客戶的需求。
blocks.en: Recommendation: Establish, at the validation stage, incubation conditions that meet the strictest requirement (EU Annex 1), and document the rationale for the choice in regulatory documents to meet the needs of customers in multiple markets.

blocks.zh: 您設施的歷史 EM 數據顯示從未分離到黴菌，是否可以用這個理由省略低溫培養？您需要什麼數據來支持這個決定？
blocks.en: Your facility's historical EM data show that no mold has ever been isolated. Can you use this as a reason to omit the low-temperature incubation? What data would you need to support this decision?

blocks.zh: 如果培養時間從 5 天縮短至 3 天，可能會錯過哪些類型的微生物？在什麼情況下這樣的縮短是合理的？
blocks.en: If the incubation time is shortened from 5 days to 3 days, what types of microorganisms might be missed? Under what circumstances is such a reduction justified?

blocks.zh: 非選擇性培養基（Nonselective media）的優點和缺點各是什麼？什麼情況下應該考慮使用選擇性培養基？
blocks.en: What are the advantages and disadvantages of nonselective media? In what situations should a selective medium be considered?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section II Summary
blocks.en: Section II Summary

blocks.zh: Alert Level vs Action Limit：兩者均非產品規格（Specification）；Alert Level 基於統計/歷史數據，需低於 Action Limit；Grade A 通常無 Alert Level（任何菌落均需行動）。EU Annex 1 (2022) 要求警報水準設定需與 CCS 整合。
blocks.en: Alert Level vs Action Limit: Neither is a product specification; the alert level is based on statistical/historical data and must be lower than the action limit; grade A usually has no alert level (any colony requires action). EU Annex 1 (2022) requires alert level setting to be integrated with the CCS.

blocks.zh: EM 與批次放行：Grade A/B 的 EM 數據必須納入批次放行審查；超標不自動等同於拒批，但必須完整調查並評估產品影響。風險導向決策是核心原則。
blocks.en: EM and batch release: Grade A/B EM data must be included in batch release review; an excursion does not automatically mean rejection, but it must be fully investigated and the product impact assessed. Risk-based decision making is the core principle.

blocks.zh: 監測計劃設計（地點/頻率/持續時間）：需基於風險評估，Grade A 需連續微粒監測；EM 本身也帶來介入風險，需平衡監測效益與操作風險；表面採樣必須在生產結束後進行。
blocks.en: Monitoring program design (location/frequency/duration): Must be based on risk assessment, with continuous particle monitoring in grade A; EM itself introduces intervention risk, so the benefit of monitoring must be balanced against operational risk; surface sampling must be done after the end of production.

blocks.zh: EM 超標調查：必須包含根本原因分析、CAPA（含責任人和時限）、產品影響評估、趨勢分析和 CAPA 有效性追蹤。調查記錄是正式 GMP 文件。
blocks.en: EM excursion investigation: Must include root cause analysis, CAPA (with owners and due dates), product impact assessment, trend analysis and follow-up on CAPA effectiveness. The investigation record is a formal GMP document.

blocks.zh: 終端滅菌產品：配製區 Grade D、充填區 Grade C 通常已足夠，但生物負荷管控（包括過濾前和充填後的 Bioburden 測試）是關鍵安全防線。
blocks.en: Terminally sterilized products: Grade D for the preparation zone and grade C for the filling zone are usually sufficient, but bioburden control (including bioburden testing before filtration and after filling) is the key line of defense.

blocks.zh: 清潔消毒：EU Annex 1 (2022) 要求 Grade A/B 定期使用孢子殺滅劑；消毒劑有效性必須針對設施自身菌株驗證；消毒劑應輪替使用；清潔是消毒的前提。
blocks.en: Cleaning and disinfection: EU Annex 1 (2022) requires regular use of a sporicide in grades A/B; disinfectant effectiveness must be validated against the facility's own isolates; disinfectants should be rotated; cleaning is a prerequisite for disinfection.

blocks.zh: 環境菌株鑑定：Table H-1 的分級鑑定策略——從形態學到菌株分型，深度與風險相匹配；建立設施菌株資料庫是追蹤菌相變化的基礎工具。
blocks.en: Identification of environmental isolates: The tiered identification strategy of Table H-1, from morphology to strain typing, matches depth to risk; building a facility isolate database is the foundation for tracking changes in flora.

blocks.zh: 培養基 GPT：每批培養基需通過生長促進測試；測試菌株需包含法定標準菌株並可加入設施環境菌株；Skip-lot testing 在滿足條件下可以接受。
blocks.en: Media GPT: Every lot of media must pass growth-promotion testing; test organisms must include compendial organisms and may include site isolates; skip-lot testing is acceptable when the conditions are met.

blocks.zh: 培養溫度：20-35°C 範圍內的單一溫度培養在大多數情況下已科學合理；EU Annex 1 (2022) 傾向雙溫（20-25°C 先行後 30-35°C）以強化酵母/黴菌回收；選擇需要根據設施菌相評估支持。
blocks.en: Incubation temperature: Single-temperature incubation within the 20-35°C range is scientifically reasonable in most cases; EU Annex 1 (2022) favors dual-temperature incubation (20-25°C first, then 30-35°C) to strengthen yeast/mold recovery; the choice must be supported by an assessment of the facility's flora.
